content.content: Who else is invited at the 'Networking event' on May 26th? Please give me their email addresses and a summary of the event.

```python
current_day = get_current_day()
# Extract year from current_day to construct the date for May 26th
# current_day format is YYYY-MM-DD
year = current_day.split('-')[0]
target_date = f"{year}-05-26"

# Search for the event
events = search_calendar_events(query="Networking event", date=target_date)

# Check if we found the event
if not events:
    # Try searching without date just in case
    events = search_calendar_events(query="Networking event", date=None)

# If still not found, raise error
if not events:
    raise ValueError("No 'Networking event' found on May 26th.")

# Assuming there's only one such event or taking the first one
event = events[0]

# Extract participants and description
participants = event.participants
description = event.description

# The user asked for "Who else", implying excluding the owner.
# However, the prompt asks for "their email addresses", so I will list all participants.
# I will also provide the summary.

print(f"Event: {event.title}")
print(f"Date: {event.start_time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}")
print(f"Summary: {description}")
print(f"Participants: {participants}")
```
